title: 1.0 W01 to W03 Content Internal HTTP Binding
wireRule: W01 maps the public /api/v1/contents family to the exact internal operations below; status=DRAFT is an authenticated owner-only social post list scoped by W03 to the W02 principal and must bypass shared public caching. Creator Center also uses the authenticated application route /api/creator/contents for owner-scoped reads; W03 never owns a public API namespace.

operations.conditionalPrincipal: For status=DRAFT, W01 must authenticate via W02; W03 requires L2+ and returns only caller-owned DRAFT posts. The request is never shared-cache eligible.

operations.subjectOwnerIdSource: W01 authenticated W02 identity projection; never client supplied
operations.eligibility: At least one W03 content row owned by ownerUserId with state=PUBLISHED, content_type in article/post/video and access_mode=PUBLIC

operations.scheduledPublishIdentity: For target state SCHEDULED, W01 resolves the current ACTIVE Creator through the existing W08_CREATOR Service Binding and forwards its canonical creatorId in X-LuckRead-Verified-Creator-Id. W03 accepts the header only over the authenticated W01 internal transport, binds the verified creatorId to the owned content record, and keeps W03 as the content-state authority.

operations.serviceCaller: W01 scheduled handler via the existing W03_CONTENT Service Binding
operations.response: W03-owned contentId, ownerUserId, creatorId, version, scheduledAt only
operations.authorizationRole: Candidate discovery only; this operation does not publish or change content state.

operations.serviceCaller: W01 scheduled handler via the existing W03_CONTENT Service Binding
operations.bodyAuthority: Each item must contain the exact W03 candidate fields plus the fresh raw W08 ALLOW decision for content.publish.own. W03 validates policyVersion=casl-l0-l8-v1, layer L3/L4, action, resourceType, ownerUserId and creatorId equality. No caller-supplied user, layer, role or state is trusted.
operations.finalMutation: W03 performs the final D1-02 compare-and-set against id, owner_user_id, creator_id, state=SCHEDULED, scheduled_at (still due), and version before setting PUBLISHED and clearing scheduled_at.
operations.idempotency: Concurrent/duplicate executions converge through the final state/version/time/owner/creator CAS; a row that no longer matches is not published again.

principal.source: W01 authoritative authentication result; never copied from public request body
principal.layerSource: W02 canonical L0-L8 resolution performed at W01 boundary; W03 uses it only for contracted creator/moderator transition gates

forwardedConventions: W01 forwards If-Match and Idempotency-Key exactly when the public operation requires them.
W01 does not forward end-user Authorization credentials to W03.
W03 treats missing/invalid caller or required principal headers as fail-closed transport/authentication failure.

verifiedCreator.source: W01 resolves the caller's current active Creator identity through the existing private W08_CREATOR Service Binding; never copied from the public request body

backgroundScheduledPublish.credentialPolicy: No Authorization, Cookie, user principal, or verified-creator headers are forwarded on either background operation.

failurePolicy.mutationRetryRule: Caller may retry only with the same Idempotency-Key where the public contract permits it.
failClosed: missing or invalid W08-verified Creator identity on a scheduled content transition
content.creatorId conflicts with the authenticated owner's current W08 Creator identity
missing W01 scheduled handler or W03_CONTENT/W08_CREATOR service binding
missing or invalid W03 due-candidate response
missing W08 ALLOW decision for a due candidate
W08 decision ownerUserId or creatorId does not match the W03 candidate
stale or concurrently changed content owner, Creator, lifecycle, scheduledAt or version at final W03 CAS

security.trustBoundary: The binding is internal; W03 has no public route for these operations.
security.principalAuthority: W01 authenticates the caller using existing AUTH contracts and sends only the resolved user id.
security.payloadOwnership: ownerUserId is never accepted from public or internal caller payloads.
security.cache: W01 preserves the public cache rules; internal responses are no-store.
security.secrets: No end-user token or Payload secret is forwarded across the binding.
security.principalLayerAuthority: W01 sends the layer returned by the existing W02 authz resolution; W03 never infers layer from cache or from the public request

evidenceRequired: negative ownership and stale If-Match evidence
W03 username redirect eligibility positive/negative public-content evidence

execution.orchestration: W01 reads due candidates from W03, obtains a fresh W08 ALLOW decision for each canonical creator identity, and submits only matching ALLOW decisions to the W03 final CAS endpoint.
execution.triggerOwnership: The existing one-minute scheduled trigger is moved from W03 to W01; W03 has no scheduled trigger after this change. No additional Worker or trigger is created.
execution.boundedWork: At most 50 due candidates per tick; W01 limits W08 authorization concurrency to 8.
